note: CBA 24.D freeze. Two groups share this file. 24.D.3 AGE-65 is every 737 pilot whose age-65 date falls within windowYears of bidEffectiveDate — they may not upgrade to Captain, which only bites for a pilot currently in an FO seat. The other types (DOWNGRADE, EQ SWAP, TRNG) are the fixed-term 24.D freezes and carry a real freezeEnd; one that falls on or before bidEffectiveDate has expired and is not enforced. In every case blockBaseChange=false lets a frozen pilot move base in the same seat.
